us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Supreme Court order injects uncertainty into mail voting before midterms
bullets: The Supreme Court gave preliminary approval for Trump’s order restricting mail voting.
AP reported the ruling may not immediately change election procedures.
The decision adds uncertainty for a method used by nearly one-third of US voters.

articles.title: Nevada crews gain ground on Hawk Fire near Reno after homes destroyed
bullets: The Hawk Fire destroyed more than 30 homes near Reno, Nevada.
Officials said containment reached 27% with no new growth reported Monday.
The fire held at about 23 square miles after forcing evacuations.

articles.title: Tropical Storm Moke brings flood risk to storm-hit Hawaii
bullets: Moke passed near Hawaii after Hurricane Lala’s impacts on the islands.
Forecasters expected up to 10 inches of rain on the Big Island.
Isolated areas could see 15 inches, raising flood and mudslide concerns.

articles.title: Former Illinois deputy convicted in Sonya Massey killing dies in prison
bullets: Sean Grayson died while serving a 20-year prison sentence.
He was convicted in the fatal shooting of Sonya Massey inside her home.
The case became a national flashpoint over police use of force.

articles.title: US consumer confidence falls again in August
bullets: The Conference Board’s consumer confidence index dipped to 89.4 in August.
The July reading was 90.2, according to AP’s business summary.
The data came amid tariff tensions and cost-of-living concerns.

articles.title: Trump says Strait of Hormuz mines cleared, warns Iran against new mining
bullets: Trump said all mines had been removed or detonated in international waters.
He said the US was monitoring the strait through Space Force capabilities.
Reuters reported oil transits remained far below prewar levels.

articles.title: Iran and Oman discuss temporary navigation corridor through Hormuz
bullets: Iran said it restarted talks with Oman on managing Strait of Hormuz traffic.
The countries discussed a joint temporary navigational corridor.
They also agreed to clear the route of mines, Reuters reported.

articles.title: Russia says it struck five vessels in Ukraine’s Black Sea ports
bullets: Russia’s Defence Ministry said it hit vessels at Pivdennyi and Odesa.
It also claimed strikes on port infrastructure and fuel facilities.
Reuters said it could not independently verify the battlefield claims.

articles.title: European leaders visit Kyiv for Ukraine’s 35th Independence Day
bullets: European leaders joined Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv on Monday.
The visit marked Ukraine’s 35th anniversary of independence.
AP reported leaders aimed to boost Ukraine’s long-range missile program.

articles.title: Kazakhstan ruling party wins parliamentary election in landslide
bullets: Kazakhstan’s pro-government Adilet Party won the parliamentary election.
AP said the result strengthens President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev’s grip on power.
Four other parties crossed the 5% threshold for parliament.

articles.title: Two Indian ships among 45 vessels blacklisted by Iran over Hormuz transit
bullets: Iran’s Persian Gulf Strait Authority listed 45 vessels as non-compliant.
The Indian vessels named were LNG tanker Disha and bulk carrier Maha Roos.
The move raises concern because Indian energy imports rely heavily on Hormuz routes.

articles.title: Ajit Doval and Wang Yi hold India-China boundary talks in Beijing
bullets: India and China held the 25th round of special representatives’ boundary talks.
The talks covered delimitation negotiations, border management and cooperation.
China’s defence ministry described the discussions as candid and in-depth.
articles.source: Ministry of National Defense of China / PublicNow

articles.title: Former CDS says Indian munition may have landed on Pakistan’s Kirana hills
bullets: Anil Chauhan said Indian loitering munitions were sent toward Sargodha and Kirana hills.
He said one may have landed on a hill while searching for radar targets.
He reiterated India did not target Pakistan’s nuclear facilities.

articles.title: CRPF sub-inspector injured in Naga-Kuki crossfire in Manipur
bullets: A CRPF sub-inspector was shot in the foot near the Senapati-Kangpokpi border.
Preliminary reports said he was caught in crossfire between village sides.
The violence disrupted traffic on the Imphal-Dimapur highway.

articles.title: NITI Aayog flags weak job linkages in generic degrees
bullets: The report highlighted BA, BSc and BCom degrees as needing reform.
The Indian Express reported more than 90% of graduates work outside aligned roles.
The finding adds to debate over employability in higher education.

articles.title: AMD jumps after Raymond James upgrade tied to AI server outlook
bullets: AMD rose about 4.9% in Tuesday trading, according to Investing.com data.
Raymond James upgraded AMD to Strong Buy.
The upgrade cited AI server growth and valuation support.

articles.title: Nvidia rebounds ahead of closely watched earnings report
bullets: Nvidia rose about 2.2% after snapping a seven-day losing streak.
Investors focused on its Wednesday earnings report after the close.
The report is widely viewed as a test of the AI trade.

articles.title: Intuit slides premarket after weak fiscal 2027 guidance
bullets: Intuit fell 11.8% in premarket trading, StreetInsider reported.
The company’s fiscal 2027 guidance missed analyst expectations.
The drop came despite a strong fourth-quarter earnings beat.

articles.title: Moderna ranks among top US stock gainers in active trading
bullets: Moderna was listed up 14.36% on Investing.com’s market movers board.
The stock traded about 49.23 million shares in the session shown.
It was the largest percentage gainer in the visible US movers table.

articles.title: Super Micro Computer advances sharply on US movers board
bullets: Super Micro Computer was listed up 9.35% by Investing.com.
The visible market-movers table showed about 48.11 million shares traded.
It ranked among the largest percentage gainers shown for US stocks.

articles.title: Canada announces retaliatory tariffs on $20 billion of US goods
bullets: Canada said it would tariff about $20 billion worth of US imports.
Products include steel, dairy, appliances and farm equipment.
AP reported the duties will take effect Sept. 8 at rates up to 50%.

articles.title: SoftBank weighs $10 billion to $20 billion bond sale tied to OpenAI financing
bullets: SoftBank is discussing a possible dollar/euro bond offering, Reuters reported.
Bloomberg said the size could range from $10 billion to $20 billion.
Proceeds would help refinance a loan tied to SoftBank’s OpenAI investment.

articles.title: Intuit shares fall after downbeat full-year outlook
bullets: Intuit projected fiscal 2027 EPS below Wall Street expectations.
Its revenue outlook also trailed consensus estimates cited by Investing.com.
Shares fell after hours as guidance overshadowed recent results.

articles.title: Zoom stock slips despite modest beat-and-raise quarter
bullets: Zoom shares fell 3.5% after hours, according to Investing.com.
The company delivered a modest Q2 beat-and-raise report.
Investors focused on softer outlook concerns in software.

articles.title: Hugging Face reportedly explores sale at $13 billion valuation
bullets: TechCrunch reported Hugging Face has been approached about a sale.
Business Insider said the potential valuation could be $13 billion or more.
No deal has been reached, according to the report.

articles.title: Nvidia faces AI growth test as Rubin chips and financing deals draw scrutiny
bullets: Nvidia’s Wednesday results are expected to test confidence in AI demand.
Reuters reported investors are watching the debut of Rubin chips.
The company’s large AI financing commitments have also drawn questions.

articles.title: Google expands Gemini Enterprise with legal-sector AI tools
bullets: Google launched Gemini Enterprise for Legal for law firms and lawyers.
The tools include integrations with legal software and AI agents.
Reuters said the move intensifies competition for legal AI customers.

articles.title: Bill Gates seeks Xi meeting to discuss AI risk controls
bullets: Gates told Reuters he wants to discuss AI safety policies with Xi Jinping.
He proposed monitoring AI’s ability to create molecules and biological threats.
He also called for international coordination on powerful AI releases.

articles.title: OpenAI cuts GPT-5.6 Sol API pricing for three months
bullets: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Sol pricing effective Aug. 21, according to pricing trackers.
Reported rates fell to $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens.
The promotional pricing is listed as running through Nov. 21.

articles.title: Nvidia unveils Jetson Orin Nano 2 for robotics and drones
bullets: Nvidia introduced the Jetson Orin Nano 2 edge AI computer.
The module targets robots, inspection systems and delivery drones.
Reports said partners including Wing and Doosan Bobcat are testing integrations.
